item.title: We need to stop paving over the paradise that is Marion County
item.description: "I completely agree with the published letter that we are not South Florida, so we need to stop permitting any and all kind of building. We are the "Horse capital of the World," and we need to remember that and the fact that our beauty is what attracted people to live here. Not our car washes. Every time I see open land gouged out, I want to cry.
